0022600103.text: Portland, 1-0 and 1st in the Northwest and the West, visits Sacramento (0-1, 4th in the Pacific, one game back) in the Trail Blazers' second game of the season, after a win at home in their only game so far. Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision. Portland won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 122-110 win in Portland on April 12, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
